basic_info.description: Experience unparalleled luxury and stunning views, in this expansive 2000+ square foot, Northeast corner condominium. This meticulously designed residence offers views of the Bay, iconic Bay Bridge, hills of the East Bay and lights of San Francisco. Enjoy the spacious layout featuring a large living room with a fireplace and direct access to private deck; dining room with built in buffet; additional office or media room offering flexibility to suit your needs; generous Master bedroom suite with double vanities and large walk-in closet in dressing area, separate soaking tub and stall shower with private commode room; Guest bedroom suite with direct access to private deck, has adjoining bathroom with closet and separate vanity in dressing area, private tub/shower and commode room; abundant closets in entry and bedroom halls and extra private storage closet conveniently located on the same floor insuring your belongings are always within reach; one deeded parking space conveniently located near garage elevator. This condominium combines functionality with style, making a perfect sanctuary for those seeking both comfort and stunning views. Don't miss this opportunity to call this extraordinary residence your new home.
